summary: Tested all 4 new AI features end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed for /api/ai/chat (SSE streaming with multi-turn session persistence in db.ai_sessions), /api/ai/design-room (returns summary/palette/picks with real DB products), /api/ai/generate-description (seller auth enforced, returns title/description/bullets/keywords), /api/ai/search (returns valid category slug + q/min_price/max_price/material). Frontend: floating TerraBot chat widget opens/streams responses and persists session_id in localStorage; widget correctly hidden on /admin, /seller/*, /login, /signup, /checkout; Category-nav 'Design my room' link visible; /ai-designer page generates picks (5 picks, 15 product cards); header sparkle AI search navigates to /category/tiles with q=matte+affordable+tiles&max_price=800; seller AddEditProductModal AI generate button populates title + 834-char description.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> nested inside <option> in status select (from x-source instrumentation wrapper) — cosmetic console warning, not blocking

critical_code_review_comments: ai_routes._load_history replays history by re-sending each user turn via chat.send_message which triggers actual LLM calls for every prior turn on every new request — this is expensive (cost/latency) and grows quadratically. Prefer emergentintegrations native session state / add_messages API or maintain history client-side inside the LlmChat instance without re-invoking the model.
ai_chat endpoint has no auth requirement and no rate limiting — could be abused for LLM quota drain. Consider IP-based rate limit or optional auth.

generate-description strips model output but does not validate title length (max 70 chars in prompt) client-side — result may exceed 70 chars (observed 55 chars OK). Only cap is 120 chars server-side.

AIChatWidget: SSE parsing uses split('

') but does not handle 'data:' lines that were split across chunks other than by the trailing boundary — current implementation buffers correctly but relies on '

' framing exclusively; acceptable given server format.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded products and sellers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All AI features work as designed. Backend uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with model gpt-5.4. SSE format 'data: {json}\n\n' with types session|delta|done|error. Chat multi-turn history stored in Mongo db.ai_sessions and replayed on each request (see code review comment about efficiency). Seller AI generate: use data-testid='product-title', 'product-description', 'ai-generate-description-btn' inside data-testid='product-modal'.
